1. Many metal nitrides can react with water to produce ammonia gas, which is toxic in high concentrations.
2. Some nitrides can be explosive when mixed with certain metals.
3. The reactions can be exothermic (generate heat).
4. Some reactions can produce hydrogen gas, which is highly flammable.
